name: SSH key sign-in of a new user or from a new address
description: A successful SSH sign-in with a public key of a user from an address (the combination) that no device had in the last 10 days. Public key authentication is generally safe, but a new combination can be unauthorized access with a stolen or added key, or lateral movement.
message: {User} signed in with an SSH key from {Source}, not seen in the last 10 days
remediation: Check that the sign-in was expected: who uses this account from that address, and which key it was (sshd log, ~/.ssh/authorized_keys). Remove keys that are not known.
